verdict.rationale: An online company-incorporation service could plausibly offer a conversational or natural-language interface, so this axis applies. The evidence describes only a form-driven web flow, where the pact is 'gerado automaticamente a partir dos dados introduzidos no formulário', with authentication, signature and payment steps. Nothing documents natural-language commands, a chatbot or an AI assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
